text:
This is a great clinic and Dr. T is the man!
They speak english here, are incredibly kind and friendly, 1/4 of the cost of the hospital one minute away, and if you need to wait, the chairs are comfortable.
I had to get my ear checked to get cleared to dive again. I came in around 2 PM, filled the form, and they let me know it would be a couple hours so I should come back closer to 3:45 PM so I didn't have to wait in the clinic. Very nice of them to give me the notice :) I came back, waited about 15 minutes, saw Dr. T and was out the door in no time.

Incredible service, the women and doctor I dealt with were amazing. Cannot thank them enough for their help. The medical centre is spotless and they are extremely helpful. If I needed medical assistance again in Koh Phangan, I'd go here. Especially as a foreigner.

I am incredibly grateful to Dr. T and his amazing team for their professionalism and care. Dr. T was highly attentive, took the time to listen to my concerns, and provided excellent advice. His expertise in diagnosing my shoulder pain and prescribing the right medication made a significant difference in my recovery, quickly alleviating the excruciating pain I was experiencing. I truly appreciate his dedication and highly recommend him to anyone in need of compassionate and effective medical care!
Great value for money. The doctor is super sweet. He's really good with children also.
Wait time wasn’t too long but practitioners did not use gloves when interacting with patients or running tests (had to ask for it), felt a little risky

Best doctor and staff. I had to go in multiple times to clean a wound and get medicine for an infection. Every time I went, I waited no longer than a few mins and Doctor T was always so kind and caring and is very good at communicating in English. All the staff there are lovely and efficient and the prices are great as well. Highly recommend Dr T!

I was there because I need a PCR test for the flight to India. Very uncomplicated and nice environment. Everyone is very friendly and it very clean.
I could pay with creditcard and it was 2,800 Baht.
They also offer antigen testing and express PCR test.

Good clinic and good doctor. Reasonable prices. I had a painful inflamed cyst behind my ear and he drained it quickly and with minimal pain. You can tell the doctor is experienced and knows what he is doing. Wait time is ok, you can sign up and come back later (they tell you estimated wait time).

Really good clinic.

I fell off my bike and a week later I went swimming in the sea (stupid idea I know) and after that I got an infection or bacteria so I need to go to the doctor.

This clinic is really awesome:
- the wait is short,
- it is clean inside,
- the prices are reasonable,
- the staff is nice
- the doctor is awesome.

I got a tetanus shot which is 900 baht and the pills and the doctor's appointment are about 800 baht.
By the way, you don't need to go to the pharmacy after the appointment, they will give you all the pills.
Very clean and up to date facility. I went for IV therapy and was pleased with the service and care
Expensive but good quality treatment. Trust them to get it right, and then charge you extra for the pleasure.

went there with massiv flu and an infection in my ears (aoe/schwimmers ear)
had to wait 30min, doc knew whats up and gave me 5 different meds. payed 50€ for everything, not worth the hassle with the insurance. Went there again 10days later to check, was free of charge. 10/10

Doctor T and his team are super professionals! Had Dengue Fever, went there for a consultation and blood tests. Doctor T is very attentive and knowledgeable,  his english is perfect, he gave me all the info and recommendations. Recommend this place!!

Overall I was happy with the threadment here. The waiting time was not to long and the doctor's assistants were very helpful. Also the doctor wasted no time and diagnosed me right away.

One thing was not ideal though: I got some medicine and did not check it immediately. When I checked it later I noticed that it was indeed penicilin even though I noted on the check in form that I am allergic to penicilin. Therefor my suggestion is to check the prescriped medicine immediately before leaving.

I have been very impressed with Dr. T! Came here for ear problems, and he gave me the full on ENT level ear cleaning / micro vacuum earwax treatment! Normally I have to go to an ENT in Chiangmai to get this, even at the hospital they don’t give the level of Service as Dr. T.

He is pleasant, kind, friendly and speaks great English. The prices are also cheaper than some of these other hospitals on the island. This is now my go to place for medical anything in Phangan. Definitely recommend!

Friendly staff and doctor. Went there for a sunburn with stage 2 burn marks and I paid 2620 baht for the removal of the blisters, cleaning the wound, anti inflammatory medicine, ibuprofene400 and some creme. I absolutely would recommend this place. They also gave me a receipt for my insurance

I came in wanting to do as many blood tests as possible to get a full understanding of where my health is as I've been having a series of issues. Dr. T took his time to consider every possible test that could help clarify certain things and then did a comprehensive write up. Never had a doctor in the states take his time to do that. Some results were back in less than 24 hours.

I would give 0 rating if I could, 1 star is too much for doctor Dr.T’s competency level.

My boyfriend had his ankle sprained (or at least that’s what we assumed  based on how swollen the foot looked). When we got there, the doctor did not even bother checking the ankle, the diagnosis was, quote: ‘I think it is a sprained ankle ‘.

When we asked about the ways of remedying this, doctor T said the best way would be to make an anti-inflammatory injection with the friendly price of 1000 baht, when we refused the injection and said we would rather prefer pills, doctor T immediately haggled the price down to 700 baht hoping we would now bust out cash. We left the hospital immediately, super frustrated and still with no remedy.

I have never faced a situation where I would have to bargain with a ‘professional ‘ in a clinic.This is unacceptable.

Sheer scam.

The clinic is fine for Thai standards! It's not a hostpital so don't expect anything perfect, but the docter helps you just fine. I was helped fairly and quick. Not much negative to say about my experience.

Excellent clinic with very good service and standard charges for Thailand (300 THB doctor fee + medicine).
Dr. Tashi is recommended by locals living on the island, and he has an English speaking team supporting him.

text: Competent, empathetic, affordable and English-speaking, Dr T is the right medical professional to see for minor ailments and illnesses. While the clinic might not be equipped to handle life-or-death-emergencies, Dr. T and his staff are the first address for everyday medical issues, from prescriptions to rashes, small wounds and other minor medical concerns. I have made a very positive experience with the clinic during my vacation and would go there anytime again.

I want to express my deep gratitude to Dr. T and all the staff of the clinic, who took me, despite the possible complications, and were by my side while I was on a drip. I have never seen such attention and care for the patient. Thank you🫶🏼 …

They charge 2,000 for one dose of the rabies vaccine

You need five injections total!

I paid 400 in Krabi

It's the most expensive price on the island

I think they overcharge a lot

I can't believe how this "doctor" is even licensed to be a physician. I had an injury due to a bike crash and didn't  make the effort to look at my wounds or even take my vitals. The only thing he did was to give me some ibuprofen which I could've got at the pharmacy myself and charged me as if I was in a state of the art hospital. He then wanted to bargain an injection for the pain by trying to charge me 100 bucks initially.. how unprofessional that is having to bargain with a physician to give you the right meds. DO NOT COME HERE!!! this guy is a scammer, they should take his license away, if he even has one. DO NOT COME!!! COMPLETE SCAMMER!!!

We came in for the iv drip at 1800 baht on the brochure, and they tried to charge us 2200 upon leaving. Maybe there was a misunderstanding but it didnt feel very honest as the sticker price is already quite high for an iv drip
Very quick and professional help, clear instructions. A bit expensive in my POV (1500 Baht for a quick dressing of wounds).
Great doctor and team :)
Can't praise Dr. T enough. He is extremely good at what he does. You can put your trust in him. Highly highly recommend his services.

he helped me very much and did so even when others gave up.
Thank you doctor, you helped save me.
Saved my muay thai training by treating my 2nd degree sunburn and also filled out everything I needed for my insurance. Thanks for everything

The best clinic on this island, going here all the time I have something wrong with body and doctor always tells me right things about how to fix it, and helps all the time. The only one doctor I trust.
Only come here if you need a prescription.
Service, price and prescription are adequate. Recommended 👍🏼 …

Great service and very reasonable. No waiting around. Straight in.

The staff was very fast and friendly
The doctor I've seen helped me a lot. Thank you for the help !
Recommended doctor at Koh Phangan for common diseases, health check-up etc.
Very friendly doctor. Spoke good English.
Brilliant
Great clinic! Very professional and kind. Came in busy hours but didn’t wait too long. And was shocked by the good price (I’m without insurance)

Be careful. I arrived here with an infected pimple. He gave me antibiotics just for 3 days (overpriced, 1,200 baht consultation) then, of course it didn’t work. ANY antibiotic needs more time (hospital later assured me)
I texted him and he offered alternative procedure for 5,000 baht (150 usd).
Or another appointment of 1,200 baht.
He will try to take as much money as possible, not caring for your health.

Within about 15 minutes, I was seen by a doctor. I hadn't brought my usual medication on vacation because of difficulties seeing my own doctor back home, as appointments had to be canceled at short notice. I was quickly and easily prescribed sufficient equivalent medication, and my problem was resolved. The cost was just under 1500 baht. The staff was very polite, their English was excellent, and the atmosphere was clean.

Thank you to the practice/clinic!

Excellent doctor's visit
Dr. Tashi Jyatsho treated me very well.

Excellent service. I went in with my sick baby and they attended to us super fast, in about 15 minutes. The test took an hour, and they sent me the results via WhatsApp. They also delivered the medication to my home. Problem solved! For less than $100 USD, very good.

The staff was friendly, professional, and very helpful. We didn't have to wait long, and the doctor really took the time to make a proper diagnosis and prescribe the right treatment.

Short, uncomplicated treatment!
Very fair price!
I highly recommend it!

Excellent service, I was very well taken care of at the clinic for a dog bite. They cleaned the wound, gave me vaccinations, and prescribed medication. Everything was explained to me clearly. 😊 …
